component.name: Power Reactor
component.summary: Battery telemetry for every connected device

description.p: Your desktop tells you when the laptop battery is low. It says nothing when your wireless mouse is about to die mid-meeting, your earbuds have five minutes left, or your phone never actually started charging on that cable.

Power Reactor watches every battery the machine can see, estimates the time remaining, and raises a desktop notification before anything dies. It follows the desktop light and dark theme and lives in the tray between glances.

ul.li: upower: laptop battery, Bluetooth devices, wireless mice and keyboards, gamepads, iPhones over USB
Android phones over USB with adb, or over Wi-Fi with KDE Connect and GSConnect
UPS units, through NUT or the USB HID power device class

description.p: A new GTK dashboard that follows the Ubuntu desktop theme, with a summary card, per-device rows, a charge trend chart and native desktop notifications.
